create_sawyer_sweep_env: create a SawyerSweepEnvV2 instance to simulate a robot arm sweeping an object to a target goal
evaluate_state_reward: evaluate the robot arm state and compute reward given observations and actions in the sweep task
compute_reward_sweep: compute the sweep task reward based on object position, gripper caging, and target proximity
reset_sweep_model: reset the sweep environment model to initial object and hand positions with optional randomization
gripper_caging_reward: compute the gripper caging reward based on pad positions relative to the object being swept
